title: Trade Republic Session Provider
status_ok: Everything is connected and running normally.
all_set_body: Home Assistant will automatically fetch portfolio and cash values. You only need to interact with this page if you change your credentials or your session expires.
restart_notice_body: Trade Republic links active sessions directly to the running live connection. When this Add-on is stopped or restarted, Trade Republic terminates the session on their servers, requiring a quick 1-tap re-confirmation in your Trade Republic app.
session_expired_hint: Please enter your PIN below and tap Confirm on your Trade Republic smartphone app to renew the session.
twofa_step1: 1. Open the Trade Republic app on your phone and tap Confirm.
twofa_step2: 2. If you received a 4-digit push code instead of an in-app prompt, enter it below.
twofa_step3: 3. Once confirmed, your session will be transferred and kept alive permanently.
lbl_2fa_code: 4-Digit Push Code (Optional — only if received via notification)
js_connecting: Connecting and solving security challenge... Please wait.
js_phone_invalid: Please enter a valid international phone number including country code (e.g. +49..., +33..., +34..., +43..., +41...).
js_pin_invalid: PIN must be 4 to 6 digits (numbers only).
js_checking_app: Checking Trade Republic app approval... Please make sure you tapped Confirm on your phone.
js_timeout_expired: ⚠️ The login challenge timed out (2 minutes exceeded). You took too long to confirm. Please start a new login.
js_session_valid: Session token is valid and active!
js_session_expired: Session token has expired or is invalid.
tip_phone: Configured Trade Republic telephone number associated with this active session.
tip_session_status: Current authentication state with Trade Republic WebSocket servers.
tip_ha_interaction: Time elapsed since Home Assistant last queried data or synced session tokens with this Add-on.
tip_health: Detailed breakdown of total API queries processed by type (Live portfolio data vs Session sync).
tip_last_checked: Time since the continuous WebSocket keeper connection was last verified active.
tip_last_data: Time since the latest live data packet (portfolio, cash, or ticker price) arrived from Trade Republic.
tip_last_token: Time since the web session JWT token was created or auto-renewed in background Chromium.
tip_last_login: Initial timestamp when the smartphone 2FA approval was confirmed for this session.
restart_required_body: Trade Republic binds active sessions directly to the running live WebSocket connection. After restarting or updating the Add-on, a 1-tap re-confirmation in the Trade Republic mobile app is required.
